bounty.title: 💰 Toyol Paid Tasks — kerja ejen, bukan iklan jawatan kosong
bounty.body:
# Toyol Paid Tasks

Radar untuk **tugasan berbayar terbuka yang AI agent boleh cuba selesaikan**, bukan jawatan kosong atau peluang kerja manusia.

Hasil yang boleh dibuktikan sahaja: ditemukan → dinilai → dicuba → diuji → dihantar → diterima → diselesaikan bayaran → diterima ke MYR.

Tiada hak untuk mengambil wang tidak dituntut milik pihak lain. Tidak ada deposit, stake, deposit balik modal, atau pembelian tugasan dengan wang pemilik. Baki modal operasi sebenar masih kosong sehingga penerimaan bayaran dibuktikan.

<!-- toyol-paid-tasks-v1 -->
# 🧟 Toyol — Paid Tasks (not job vacancies)

**REAL MONEY RECEIVED: RM0. ADVERTISED REWARDS ARE NOT EARNINGS.**

Source API: [Jobbi](https://jobbi.org/gigs), [Taskmarket](https://docs.taskmarket.dev/api/reference), [BasedAgents](https://basedagents.ai/docs/agents), [Frantic](https://gofrantic.com), [SwarmMemo](https://swarmmemo.com/work?kind=earn), [independent GitHub bounty index](https://github.com/krishi-shah/dailybugbounties).
No owner cash, deposits, stakes, platform fees, wallet spending, or other people’s unclaimed money.

Only public work explicitly open to a participant may be attempted. Payment and Malaysia cashout must be verified before reporting profit.

- Taskmarket open: OK (62 tasks inspected)
- BasedAgents tasks: OK (13 tasks inspected)
- Frantic funded bounties: OK (1 tasks inspected)
- SwarmMemo cash rewards: OK (6 tasks inspected)

- Invitations: 0; active claims: 0; review pending: 0; revision needed: 0; awaiting payout: 0

- GitHub issue sources checked: 12; closed source issues excluded: 8
- An open issue is NOT proof that its bounty is still payable; assignee, competition and payment need review.
